'''Forest Magic''' permanently unlocks the ability to read the language of the [[Junimos]]. It is rewarded to [[the Player]] upon finishing the [[Quests#Meet The Wizard|Meet The Wizard]] quest, which is unlocked the morning after the player examines the first golden scroll in the Community Center.

Once obtained, the Forest Magic power can be found in the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab in [[the Player]]'s Menu.

==History==
